fields.finding: Illustrative 1.25-times-screen axial tests reach 1.00213 and 0.94965 MN and exceed the respective source screen. The frames require 750 part screens and qualification of 1500 end interfaces; amplified bending does not scale solely with axial-force ratio.
fields.remaining: Validate proof fixtures, stress coverage, confinement and damage effects, inspection detection, accept/reject criteria and lifetime treatment. Supplier capability, throughput, scrap and pricing remain unknown.
